subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your upcoming hotel reservation at the Grandview Hotel from July 15th to July 20th, 2022. Your booking includes a deluxe room with a sea view and complimentary breakfast. Please note that check-in time is at 3:00 PM and check-out time is at 11:00 AM. If you have any special requests or need to make changes to your reservation, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you at our hotel. Best regards, The Grandview Hotel Team
